episodes.synopsis: Young swordsman Roan and his comrade Yufa face a spreading darkness after meeting a blindfolded mage.
episodes.title: Why Do You Wield That Sword?

episodes.synopsis: Roan and Yufa look for the Golden Thief Bug and a girl named Maya threatens to hinder their progress.
episodes.title: Be Good to Me, Big Brother

episodes.synopsis: Roan and his band join forces with Takius as they journey into the pits and haunted dungeons beneath Geffen Tower.
episodes.title: I Believe

episodes.synopsis: Roan, Yufa, Maya and Takius return to the dungeons of Geffen Tower to defeat the evil that plagues the tower.
episodes.title: Is That the Best You Can Do?

episodes.synopsis: A shocking revelation turns Yufa's world upside down and tensions begin to mount.
episodes.title: What Did You Just Say?

episodes.synopsis: Yufa sets out for a reunion after hearing that her brother may still be alive.
episodes.title: I Won't Let Anyone Get in My Way!

episodes.synopsis: Roan and his comrades journey to Alberta to investigate a monster infestation.
episodes.title: Will You Comfort Me?!?

episodes.synopsis: The travelers take a shortcut through the notorious Labyrinth Forest, only to talk in circles.
episodes.title: Life Is Precious

episodes.synopsis: Takius convinces the travelers to make a detour to an underground lair inhabited by enormous ants.
episodes.title: All for the Truth

episodes.synopsis: Roan and friends reach the city of Morroc, home of the Thief's Guild.
episodes.title: You're My Brother, Aren't You?!?

episodes.synopsis: Rai is tricked into opening the tomb of King Osiris, unleashing a horde of ghastly monsters.
episodes.title: All Is Only Despair

episodes.synopsis: Following the battle with Osiris, the group heads toward the Assassin's guild; Yufa struggles with her brother's death.
episodes.title: I Can't Do It

episodes.synopsis: Roan must join forces with adversaries to protect Yufa.
episodes.title: The Protector

episodes.synopsis: The clock tower's bell begins to ring, summoning lethal monsters.
episodes.title: Why Won't You Answer?

episodes.synopsis: Roan returns from his mission with new skills and the rank of a fully-ordained Crusader.
episodes.title: Don't Worry, I'm Here

episodes.synopsis: Roan and his group travel to the ancient city of Payon to stop a outbreak of violent and destructive monsters.
episodes.title: I Can't Save Anyone

episodes.synopsis: While Roan and a group of Archers attempt to hold off the monsters, Takius's master makes his presence known; Yufa prepares herself for challenges that could earn her the title of Priest.
episodes.title: You Are Already Tainted

episodes.synopsis: Roan may have uncovered the key to stopping the monsters; Yufa rejoins her friends as a newly-appointed Priest.
episodes.title: I've Known All Along

episodes.synopsis: Missing the ferry to the Parol Lighthouse turns out to be more than just bad luck.
episodes.title: We'll Always Be Together

episodes.synopsis: Maya is devastated over her role in what happened to Alice; Yufa continues her battle with Haze.
episodes.title: It's Okay

episodes.synopsis: Haze and Zealotus continue to spread darkness throughout the realm; Roan crosses paths with the Dark Lord's emissaries of destruction.
episodes.title: I Need You

episodes.synopsis: The group finally reaches Comodo, where they encounter familiar rivals; Iruga vows to save Keough; Comodo must be snatched from the clutches of a deadly scourge.
episodes.title: Who's the Lonely One?

episodes.synopsis: Comodo is under siege while Roan, Iruga, and Judia fight to stave off the onslaught of an army of monsters.
episodes.title: Good Bye

episodes.synopsis: Roan's group travels to Glast Heim in search of Yufa and her dangerous brother Haze.
episodes.title: Place of Reckoning

episodes.synopsis: Roan watches Yufa suffer at the hands of Haze; Takius and Zephyr finally meet on the field of battle.
episodes.title: One Who Realizes His Mistake

episodes.synopsis: The Dark Lord's return is imminent, and Roan will have to use every skill to overcome this hideous force of evil.
episodes.title: For the Sake of Our Future
